passages.text: “Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel and Judah.
God tells them what to say to their family.
Say to your brothers, "You are my people."
Say to your sisters, "You are my loved one."
passages.original: אִמְר֥וּ לַאֲחֵיכֶ֖ם עַמִּ֑י וְלַאֲחֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם רֻחָֽמָה׃

passages.text: Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not My wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove the adultery from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God calls Israel unfaithful.
God says, "Rebuke your mother."
God commands, "Rebuke her."
God says, "She is not My wife."
God says, "I am not her husband."
God commands her to stop her adultery.
God says, "Let her remove the adultery from her face."
God says, "Let her remove the unfaithfulness from between her breasts."
passages.original: רִ֤יבוּ בְאִמְּכֶם֙ רִ֔יבוּ כִּֽי־ הִיא֙ לֹ֣א אִשְׁתִּ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֣א אִישָׁ֑הּ וְתָסֵ֤ר זְנוּנֶ֙יהָ֙ מִפָּנֶ֔יה וְנַאֲפוּפֶ֖יהָ מִבֵּ֥ין שָׁדֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Otherwise, I will strip her naked and expose her like the day of her birth. I will make her like a desert and turn her into a parched land, and I will let her die of thirst.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel as a husband speaks to an unfaithful wife.
God warns Israel.
If Israel does not turn from unfaithfulness, God will act.
God will strip Israel naked.
God will expose Israel as she was on the day she was born.
God will make Israel like a desert.
God will turn Israel into a dry, parched land.
God will let Israel die of thirst.
passages.original: פֶּן־ אַפְשִׁיטֶ֣נָּה עֲרֻמָּ֔ה וְהִ֨צַּגְתִּ֔יהָ כְּי֖וֹם הִוָּֽלְדָ֑הּ וְשַׂמְתִּ֣יהָ כַמִּדְבָּ֗ר וְשַׁתִּ֙הָ֙ כְּאֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֔ה וַהֲמִתִּ֖יהָ בַּצָּמָֽא׃

passages.text: I will have no compassion on her children, because they are the children of adultery.
passages.sermon: God speaks about Israel.\r\nGod says, "I will not show mercy to her children."\r\nHer children are children of adultery.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בָּנֶ֖יהָ לֹ֣א אֲרַחֵ֑ם כִּֽי־ בְנֵ֥י זְנוּנִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה׃

passages.text: For their mother has played the harlot and has conceived them in disgrace. For she thought, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me bread and water, wool and linen, oil and drink.’
passages.sermon:
The mother of these children acted unfaithfully.
She brought shame to herself when she gave birth to them.
She said, “I will go after my lovers.”
These lovers give me bread.
They give me water.
They give me wool.
They give me linen.
They give me oil.
They give me drink.
passages.original: כִּ֤י זָֽנְתָה֙ אִמָּ֔ם הֹבִ֖ישָׁה הֽוֹרָתָ֑ם כִּ֣י אָמְרָ֗ה אֵלְכָ֞ה אַחֲרֵ֤י מְאַהֲבַי֙ נֹתְנֵ֤י לַחְמִי֙ וּמֵימַ֔י צַמְרִ֣י וּפִשְׁתִּ֔י שַׁמְנִ֖י וְשִׁקּוּיָֽי׃

passages.text: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up her path with thorns; I will enclose her with a wall, so she cannot find her way.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
Israel has been unfaithful.
God says, “I will block your path with thorns.”
I will build a wall around you.
You will not find your way.
passages.original: לָכֵ֛ן הִנְנִי־ שָׂ֥ךְ אֶת־ דַּרְכֵּ֖ךְ בַּסִּירִ֑ים וְגָֽדַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־ גְּדֵרָ֔הּ וּנְתִיבוֹתֶ֖יהָ לֹ֥א תִמְצָֽא׃

passages.text: She will pursue her lovers but not catch them; she will seek them but not find them. Then she will say, ‘I will return to my first husband, for then I was better off than now.’
passages.sermon:
Israel turned away from God.
Israel chased after other gods and idols.
She tried to find satisfaction from her lovers.
She could not catch them.
She looked for them.
She could not find them.
Then she spoke to herself.
She said, “I will go back to my first husband.”
She remembered her life with God.
She said, “I was better off then than I am now.”
passages.original: וְרִדְּפָ֤ה אֶת־ מְאַהֲבֶ֙יהָ֙ וְלֹֽא־ תַשִּׂ֣יג אֹתָ֔ם וּבִקְשָׁ֖תַם וְלֹ֣א תִמְצָ֑א וְאָמְרָ֗ה אֵלְכָ֤ה וְאָשׁ֙וּבָה֙ אֶל־ אִישִׁ֣י הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן כִּ֣י ט֥וֹב לִ֛י אָ֖ז מֵעָֽתָּה׃

passages.text: For she does not acknowledge that it was I who gave her grain, new wine, and oil, who lavished on her silver and gold— which they crafted for Baal.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Israel.
Israel does not know the truth.
I am God.
I gave Israel grain.
I gave Israel new wine.
I gave Israel oil.
I gave Israel much silver.
I gave Israel much gold.
Israel used the silver and gold for Baal.
passages.original: וְהִיא֙ לֹ֣א יָֽדְעָ֔ה כִּ֤י אָֽנֹכִי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔הּ הַדָּגָ֖ן וְהַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֑ר וְכֶ֨סֶף הִרְבֵּ֥יתִי לָ֛הּ וְזָהָ֖ב עָשׂ֥וּ לַבָּֽעַל׃

passages.text: Therefore I will take back My grain in its time and My new wine in its season; I will take away My wool and linen, which were given to cover her nakedness.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel, who has been unfaithful.
God gave Israel grain, new wine, wool, and linen.
Israel used these gifts for idols.
God says, "Therefore, I will act."
God will take back His grain at the proper time.
God will take back His new wine in its season.
God will remove His wool and linen.
God gave the wool and linen to cover Israel's nakedness.
God will no longer let Israel have these gifts.
passages.original: לָכֵ֣ן אָשׁ֔וּב וְלָקַחְתִּ֤י דְגָנִי֙ בְּעִתּ֔וֹ וְתִירוֹשִׁ֖י בְּמֽוֹעֲד֑וֹ וְהִצַּלְתִּי֙ צַמְרִ֣י וּפִשְׁתִּ֔י לְכַסּ֖וֹת אֶת־ עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: And then I will expose her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of My hands.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Israel.
God says, “I will show her shame.
I will do this in front of her lovers.
No one will save her from My power.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה אֲגַלֶּ֥ה אֶת־ נַבְלֻתָ֖הּ לְעֵינֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑יהָ וְאִ֖ישׁ לֹֽא־ יַצִּילֶ֥נָּה מִיָּדִֽי׃

passages.text: I will put an end to all her exultation: her feasts, New Moons, and Sabbaths— all her appointed feasts.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Israel.
God will stop all her joy.
God will end her feasts.
God will end her New Moon celebrations.
God will end her Sabbaths.
God will end all her appointed festivals.
passages.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ כָּל־ מְשׂוֹשָׂ֔הּ חַגָּ֖הּ חָדְשָׁ֣הּ וְשַׁבַּתָּ֑הּ וְכֹ֖ל מוֹעֲדָֽהּ׃

passages.text: I will destroy her vines and fig trees, which she thinks are the wages paid by her lovers. So I will make them into a thicket, and the beasts of the field will devour them.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Israel.
God says, “I will destroy her vines.
I will destroy her fig trees.
She believes her lovers gave these to her as payment.
I will turn her vines and fig trees into a thicket.
Wild animals will eat them.”
passages.original: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִ֗י גַּפְנָהּ֙ וּתְאֵ֣נָתָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמְרָ֗ה אֶתְנָ֥ה הֵ֙מָּה֙ לִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתְנוּ־ לִ֖י מְאַֽהֲבָ֑י וְשַׂמְתִּ֣ים לְיַ֔עַר וַאֲכָלָ֖תַם חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃

passages.text: I will punish her for the days of the Baals when she burned incense to them, when she decked herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers. But Me she forgot,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD says He will punish her.
She worshiped the Baals.
She burned incense to the Baals.
She put on rings and jewelry for the Baals.
She followed her lovers.
She forgot the LORD.
passages.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י עָלֶ֗יהָ אֶת־ יְמֵ֤י הַבְּעָלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּקְטִ֣יר לָהֶ֔ם וַתַּ֤עַד נִזְמָהּ֙ וְחֶלְיָתָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑יהָ וְאֹתִ֥י שָׁכְחָ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: “Therefore, behold, I will allure her and lead her to the wilderness, and speak to her tenderly.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
Israel has been unfaithful.
God says, “Therefore, I will allure her.
I will lead Israel into the wilderness.
I will speak to her heart.
I will speak to her with kindness.”
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מְפַתֶּ֔יהָ וְהֹֽלַכְתִּ֖יהָ הַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְדִבַּרְתִּ֖י עַל לִבָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: There I will give back her vineyards and make the Valley of Achor into a gateway of hope. There she will respond as she did in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God promises to restore Israel’s blessings.
God says, “I will give her back her vineyards from there.”
God says, “I will make the Valley of Achor a door of hope.”
Israel will answer Me there.
She will answer as she did in her youth.
She will answer as on the day she came up from Egypt.
passages.original: וְנָתַ֨תִּי לָ֤הּ אֶת־ כְּרָמֶ֙יהָ֙ מִשָּׁ֔ם וְאֶת־ עֵ֥מֶק עָכ֖וֹר לְפֶ֣תַח תִּקְוָ֑ה וְעָ֤נְתָה שָּׁ֙מָּה֙ כִּימֵ֣י נְעוּרֶ֔יהָ וִּכְי֖וֹם עֲלֹתָ֥הּ מֵאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ס

passages.text: In that day,” declares the LORD, “you will call Me ‘my Husband,’ and no longer call Me ‘my Master.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His people.
He promises a future day.
On that day, the LORD will change their relationship.
The people will call the LORD “my Husband.”
They will not call the LORD “my Master” anymore.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֤ה בַיּוֹם־ הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה תִּקְרְאִ֖י אִישִׁ֑י וְלֹֽא־ תִקְרְאִי־ לִ֥י ע֖וֹד בַּעְלִֽי׃

passages.text: For I will remove from her lips the names of the Baals; no longer will their names be invoked.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Israel.
God says, “I will remove the names of the Baals from her mouth.
She will not speak their names anymore.
People will not remember the Baals by name again.”
passages.original: וַהֲסִרֹתִ֛י אֶת־ שְׁמ֥וֹת הַבְּעָלִ֖ים מִפִּ֑יהָ וְלֹֽא־ יִזָּכְר֥וּ ע֖וֹד בִּשְׁמָֽם׃

passages.text: On that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air and the creatures that crawl on the ground. And I will abolish bow and sword and weapons of war in the land, and will make them lie down in safety.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His people.
He promises a new day.
On that day, the LORD will make a covenant for His people.
He will make this covenant with the beasts of the field.
He will make it with the birds of the air.
He will make it with the creatures that crawl on the ground.
The LORD will remove the bow from the land.
He will remove the sword from the land.
He will remove all weapons of war from the land.
The LORD will cause His people to lie down in safety.
passages.original: וְכָרַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֤ם בְּרִית֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא עִם־ חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְעִם־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְרֶ֖מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וְקֶ֨שֶׁת וְחֶ֤רֶב וּמִלְחָמָה֙ אֶשְׁבּ֣וֹר מִן־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִשְׁכַּבְתִּ֖ים לָבֶֽטַח׃

passages.text: So I will betroth you to Me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises to join them to Himself forever.
God will make them His own people.
God will join them in righteousness.
God will join them in justice.
God will join them in loving devotion.
God will join them in compassion.
passages.original: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִ֖י לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִי֙ בְּצֶ֣דֶק וּבְמִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּבְחֶ֖סֶד וּֽבְרַחֲמִֽים׃

passages.text: And I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will know the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises to join them to Himself.
God will do this with faithfulness.
God will make them His own forever.
They will know the LORD.
passages.original: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִ֖י בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: “On that day I will respond—” declares the LORD— “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD declares a promise.
The LORD says, “On that day, I will respond.
I will answer the heavens.
The heavens will answer the earth.”
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא אֶֽעֱנֶה֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶעֱנֶ֖ה אֶת־ הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְהֵ֖ם יַעֲנ֥וּ אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And the earth will respond to the grain, to the new wine and oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.
passages.sermon:
The earth will answer the grain.
The earth will answer the new wine.
The earth will answer the oil.
The grain, new wine, and oil will answer Jezreel.
passages.original: וְהָאָ֣רֶץ תַּעֲנֶ֔ה אֶת־ הַדָּגָ֖ן וְאֶת־ הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְאֶת־ הַיִּצְהָ֑ר וְהֵ֖ם יַעֲנ֥וּ אֶֽת־ יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃

passages.text: And I will sow her as My own in the land, and I will have compassion on ‘No Compassion.’ I will say to those called ‘Not My People,’ ‘You are My people,’ and they will say, ‘You are my God.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD promises to act.
The LORD will plant Israel in the land as His own people.
The LORD will show compassion to those called ‘No Compassion.’
The LORD will say to those called ‘Not My People,’ “You are My people.”
They will answer the LORD.
They will say to the LORD, “You are my God.”
passages.original: וּזְרַעְתִּ֤יהָ לִּי֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְרִֽחַמְתִּ֖י אֶת־ לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה וְאָמַרְתִּ֤י לְלֹֽא־ עַמִּי֙ עַמִּי־ אַ֔תָּה וְה֖וּא יֹאמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽי׃פ
